card.name: Words just before an expected verb phrase
card.fires_on: Scattered function words such as 'to', 'with', 'Don't' and verbs like 'forced' or 'advised to' in general web text, where a verb or noun phrase is about to follow. No single word or topic ties them together.

modes.label: Infinitive 'to' after advise or force
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'advised' or 'forced', right before an action verb.
modes.example: several thousand people in Jackson were advised<< to>> pack their bags in case a fire in

modes.label: Patent-style phrasing
modes.description: Words inside stock technical patent phrases about data processing systems.
modes.example: is depicted in accordance<< with>> the present invention.

modes.label: Start of a tech term list
modes.description: The first word of a multi-word technology term in a list of topics.
modes.example: Voice Over Internet Protocol,<< Artificial>> Neural Network (ANN)
